label: Projections are ESTIMATES from a simple model, not Fantrax projections.

sources.matchup: Week 7 opponent factors computed from nflverse play_by_play_2026 weeks 1-6: tackle points the opponent offense concedes to DL/LB/DB per game (pbp tackler ids mapped to position), sacks and sacks+QB hits allowed per dropback (OL pass-block proxy), dropbacks, run plays and completions per game, PD+INT allowed per game; weighted by each player's own tackle/pass-rush/ball-skill point mix
sources.injuries: nflverse injuries_2026 week 7; players.csv status (RES/PUP/NFI/SUS excluded)
sources.schedule: nflverse nfldata games.csv (remaining weeks 7-17 for ROS)
sources.greenDots: Mike Woellert week 6 asOf 2026-10-20T05:24:49-07:00 (https://mikewoellert.substack.com/p/2026-week-6-green-dot-and-full-time-linebackers-idp-fantasy-football) — W7 list not yet out
sources.previousFile: week 7 file (rank movers compare against it)

unverified: PFF pass-block win rate / true pressure rate: NOT used (paywalled, unverified); OL strength uses nflverse sacks + QB hits per dropback as a proxy
nflverse qb_hit is a hit count, not pressures (hurries are not in pbp)
Stuffs and FR yards are not in nflverse and are left out of WU scoring
ROS assumes current role/rate holds; fantasy horizon weeks 7-17 (14-wk regular season + 3 playoff weeks)

method.weekly: proj = (60% last-3 + 40% season FP/G) x snap trend x Week-7 matchup x green dot x injury; weeklyRank sorts proj
method.ros: rosPts = Week-7 proj + sum over weeks 8-17 of (50/50 season & last-3 FP/G x role (L3 vs season snaps, 0.9-1.1) x green dot x that week's opponent factor); byes = 0; rosRank sorts rosPts
method.injury: Q x0.9, D x0.35, Out/Suspended 0, missed last week with prior-week Out/D tag x0.5, missed last week untagged x0.75, IR excluded
